primary_decision: Stop Resize/Letterbox race; neither candidate meets repeatable >=1ms completed input-ready saving and per-block P95/P99 nonregression. No system A/B is admitted by this result.
scope_of_stats: Completed stereo batch2 preprocessing only. Graph execution/output clone occurs after timing. These numbers are not pure GPU kernel, Engine, detector or system cycle latency.

telemetry_alignment.method: Exact UTC-ns inclusion for telemetry.jsonl. Per 100-frame segment windows include untimed Graph work between preprocessing samples. Separate exact-preprocess-interval point count supplied; no per-frame frequency interpolation.
telemetry_alignment.tegra_method: Human local timestamps interpreted as UTC+08:00 from run context; one-second timestamp buckets. Only fully-contained buckets are used for strict segment aggregate; boundary-overlap alternatives are labeled in segments. Tegrastats cannot be mapped to individual 8ms preprocess intervals.
